title: Australian Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole dish originating from Australia, featuring tender chicken, aromatic spices, and a satisfying casserole.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Transfer the chicken to the casserole dish, then pour the onion and garlic mixture over the top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
